Attached are the draft findings from the penetration test we ran on your environment last week (2026-01-12/13). We identified three medium-priority issues and two low-priority items. High-level summary: 
- Auth bypass via legacy API endpoint (medium)
- S3 object ACL exposing staging artifacts (medium)
- CSRF on internal admin routes (low)

Attachments: ACME_Pentest_Report_trimmed.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB); exploit-repro-20260114.zip (zip, 4.2MB)

- Auth bypass (legacy API): owner = @marcus_lin (platform-api team), initial triage complete, fix target: 1 week (patch to staging by 1/26).
- S3 ACL (staging artifacts): owner = infra-team (I can take lead for coordination), fix target: 3 days (policy change + manifest update by 1/22).
- CSRF (internal admin): owner = @dev_patel (web-team), fix target: 4 days (1/23) — will add CSRF tokens and run regression.

Quick update: I confirmed the staging S3 bucket was created outside of the main Terraform modules (hand-provisioned in 2022). I revoked the public ACL on the object and updated the bucket policy. Changes deployed to staging at 16:10 PST — ACL now private.

Verification: 
- Manual GET to previously public object now returns 403.
- Uploaded remediation verification logs to Drive (file: s3-acl-remediation-verify-20260120.log).

Next: open PR to migrate the bucket to Terraform and add an automated policy to prevent public ACLs. I expect the PR by EOD 1/22.

-Marcus
